product_overview: A custom Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) designed as an integrated internal tool to manage laboratory inventory, instruments and calibrations, and AI-assisted workflows. It streamlines lab operations by combining inventory control, instrument lifecycle management, and agentic AI chat functionalities into a unified web application.
core_goals: Provide comprehensive inventory management for reagents, standards, consumables, and training usage with automated stock tracking and alerts.
Offer detailed instrument and calibration management with scheduling, reminders, and maintenance logs to ensure compliance and operational readiness.
Integrate AI chat functionality that interfaces with the system to provide real-time information and assistance based on lab data.
Automate routine notifications and workflows using n8n for background jobs such as reports and reminders.
Support role-based access control ensuring secure and appropriate data access for admins, managers, and analysts.
Enhance user productivity with an intuitive dashboard, search filters, visual data charts, and seamless CRUD operations.
key_features: Authentication with role-based access control (admin, manager, analyst) via Supabase Auth and custom flow.
Dashboard displaying key statistics such as reagent, standard, item, instrument counts, pending orders, and calendar events.
Reagents, standards, consumables, and instruments catalog management with full CRUD functionality and detailed views.
Warehouse inventory management with batch and stock level tracking including FEFO recommendations and expiry monitoring.
Order management system with approval workflow requiring manager/admin confirmation for all orders.
Training sets management to track usage of inventory items per training batch with automatic stock adjustments.
Usage logs to audit chemical and consumable usage with user and timestamp details.
Instrument calibration and maintenance logs with scheduling, automatic status updates and email reminders.
Admin user management including user creation, editing, role assignments, and deletion.
AI chat interface integrated with n8n webhook for querying inventory status, instrument data, MSDS info, and operational instructions.
File upload and storage supporting document and image management for MSDS, calibration reports, and maintenance photos.
Calendar and scheduling features to visualize calibration and maintenance events.
user_flow_summary: Users authenticate via a secure login page with role-based access determining the available features.
After login, users access the main dashboard showing an overview of inventory stock levels, instrument statuses, upcoming calibrations, and recent activity.
Admins and managers navigate to inventory catalogs (reagents, standards, consumables) to create, update, or delete entries, manage warehouse stock, and place or approve orders.
Analysts can view stock statuses, submit usage logs, and participate in training usage workflows to ensure accurate inventory decrement.
Instrument managers update calibration schedules and maintenance logs, with automated reminders triggered for upcoming or overdue calibrations.
Users interact with the AI chat assistant to query real-time lab data via the n8n webhook bridge, receiving insights on stock, instrument status, and procedural guides.
Automated background jobs in n8n send daily email reports on expiring or low-stock items and calibration reminders to stakeholders.
Users upload and manage relevant documentation (MSDS, maintenance photos, calibration reports) tied to respective inventory or instrument entries.
validation_criteria: User authentication enforces correct role-based permissions for accessing sensitive inventory and admin functions.
Inventory CRUD operations accurately reflect in both catalog and warehouse stock data with correct FEFO priority applied.
Order creation triggers an approval workflow requiring manager/admin confirmation before finalization.
Training usage correctly deducts inventory quantities, and usage logs are recorded with accurate user and timestamp data.
Instrument calibration and maintenance records update statuses and schedules with automatic email notifications sent as scheduled.
AI chat interface responds reliably with current data obtained via n8n webhook integration and handles webhook unavailability gracefully.
File uploads and downloads function correctly supporting MSDS, calibration documents, and images with proper storage and retrieval.
Dashboard statistics and charts dynamically update to reflect real-time inventory levels, instrument statuses, and scheduled events.
Automated background jobs run successfully on schedule to send email reminders and reports.
UI confirms user actions prompting for confirmation on potentially destructive operations (e.g., deletions).

features.name: Authentication
features.description: User login/logout with role-based access (admin, manager, analyst). Uses Supabase Auth with custom username/password/role login flow.

features.name: Dashboard
features.description: Main dashboard with statistics charts, recent activities, and quick access to key features. Shows reagent/standard/item/instrument counts and pending orders.

features.name: Reagents Management
features.description: CRUD operations for reagent catalog. Includes search, filtering, and inventory management.

features.name: Standards Management
features.description: CRUD operations for certified reference materials and standards catalog.

features.name: Items Management
features.description: CRUD operations for consumable items catalog (pipette tips, gloves, etc.).

features.name: Orders Management
features.description: Create and manage purchase orders with approval workflow. Manager/Admin can approve orders.

features.name: Training Sets
features.description: Manage training sets for analyst competency training with detail views.

features.name: Usage Logs
features.description: Track chemical and item usage with audit logging.

features.name: Warehouse Chemicals
features.description: Manage individual chemical stock items in warehouse with batch tracking.

features.name: Warehouse Items
features.description: Manage individual consumable items in warehouse with stock tracking.

features.name: Instruments Database
features.description: CRUD operations for laboratory instruments with calibration status tracking and detail views.

features.name: Calibration Logs
features.description: Track and manage instrument calibration history with automatic status updates.

features.name: Maintenance Logs
features.description: Track instrument maintenance activities and history.

features.name: Admin User Management
features.description: Admin-only user management with create, edit, delete operations. Role assignment for admin/manager/analyst.

features.name: Chat AI
features.description: AI assistant chat interface with n8n webhook integration. Provides fallback responses when webhook unavailable.

features.name: File Upload
features.description: File upload/download service with Supabase Storage. Supports images, documents, calibration reports, and maintenance photos.

features.name: Schedule/Calendar
features.description: Calendar view for scheduled events including calibrations and maintenance.
